summary.head: 2328b07
summary.scope: Merged PRs #44, #46 and #47 plus QA fixes

test_counts.notes: Aggregate final executions: 383 local PostgreSQL API, 383 CI MariaDB API, 130 full browser, and 2 added subscription browser tests. CI PostgreSQL and focused reruns are corroborative and not double-counted. Expected mutation failures are excluded.

findings.title: Disabled server billing gate still paywalled every client
Stale journey context overrode the newly selected city's weather
Playwright regression suite is not run in CI
Working tree changed the Expo slug back to interlude
API tests depended on the live public OSRM router

coverage_gaps: No native iOS or Android device E2E
No complete WCAG or native screen-reader audit
No load, soak, cold-start or offline test
In-app purchase and receipt refresh are not implemented
untested_risks: Expo project rename and remote build-number state
Apple and Google store purchase lifecycle
Live provider inventory, quotas and confirmations
Production queue worker and scheduler lifetime
Native deep-link, push and permission behaviour
